author: Yuzu Octopus
description: Pure Dracula brand theme for Astryx React sites. Dark-only tokens, syntax highlighting, and chart colors with prebuilt CSS.
name: astryx-dracula

scripts.theme:build: bun run icons:build && bunx astryx theme build astryx-theme.ts -o theme.css --icons-specifier ./icons.mjs
scripts.icons:build: bun build icons.tsx --outfile icons.mjs --format esm --external react --external lucide-react
scripts.theme:check: bun run icons:check && bunx astryx theme build astryx-theme.ts -o theme.css --icons-specifier ./icons.mjs --check --json | bun -e 'const r = JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()); if (r.type !== "theme.build.check") { console.error("theme:check: unexpected CLI response " + JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 200)); process.exit(1); } const stale = r.data.stale.filter(s => s.path !== "astryx-dracula.js"); for (const s of stale) console.error("stale: " + s.path + " (" + s.reason + ")"); if (stale.length) process.exit(1); const entry = await import("./astryx-dracula.js"); if (!entry.astryxDraculaTheme || !entry.draculaIconRegistry) { console.error("astryx-dracula.js is missing its theme or icon registry export"); process.exit(1); } console.log("theme outputs up to date; astryx-dracula.js (hand-maintained) loads and exports");' && bun run entry:check
scripts.icons:check: bun build icons.tsx --outfile .tmp-icons.mjs --format esm --external react --external lucide-react; s=$?; cmp -s .tmp-icons.mjs icons.mjs; c=$?; rm -f .tmp-icons.mjs; [ $s -eq 0 ] && [ $c -eq 0 ] || { echo 'stale: icons.mjs (rerun bun run icons:build)'; exit 1; }
scripts.entry:check: node -e "const{pathToFileURL}=require('url');const{resolve}=require('path');import(pathToFileURL(resolve('astryx-dracula.js')).href).then(m=>{if(!m.astryxDraculaTheme||!m.draculaIconRegistry){console.error('astryx-dracula.js is missing its theme or icon registry export');process.exit(1)}console.log('astryx-dracula.js loads under plain Node ESM')}).catch(e=>{console.error('astryx-dracula.js is not importable by Node ESM: '+e.message);process.exit(1)})"
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run theme:check && bun run icons:check && bun run entry:check && bun run audit && tsc --noEmit && bunx react-doctor@latest --score
